Generated Narrative: ImplementationGuide hl7.at.fhir.elga.aps.r4

ELGAAustrianPatientSummaryR4

The official URL for this implementation guide is: 

https://fhir.hl7.at/elga/aps/r4/ImplementationGuide/hl7.at.fhir.elga.aps.r4

The FHIR® implementation guide Austrian Patient Summary is derived from the HL7® Austria FHIR® Core implementation guide and ensures conformity with the International Patient Summary (IPS).
